decisions.reason: Changing SPI MOSI to GPIO47 does not alter the I2C bus speed, pull-ups, cable length, or signal-conditioning requirements.
The switched 5V rail remains controlled by GPIO5; the source changes only SPI MOSI and does not reassign 5V_EN.
The SPI MOSI assignment does not change the standalone regulator, its activation condition, powered rail, or source-selection topology.
The LED standby cutoff remains controlled by GPIO5, and the source does not change that control assignment or cutoff behavior.
The GPIO reassignment has no necessary effect on component availability, cost, or connector-sourceability policy.
The defined power-to-main signal connector does not include SPI MOSI, and the source does not change either connector or its pinout.
Changing SPI MOSI to GPIO47 does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or 3.3V power-path requirements.
The source does not establish that SPI MOSI controls the SK6812 LED board and does not change its board role, LED count, or LED family.
The sensor-board requirement concerns I2C sensor connectors and their 3.3V supply; the SPI MOSI reassignment does not necessarily change those interfaces.
